subject: Orbitek vendor activation: COI and PO steps
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@orbitek.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding: initial COI and PO information

Hi Jordan / Grace,

Thanks for the warm welcome — excited to get Orbitek live on Redwood. Attached is our standard COI (Orbitek_COI_20270214.pdf) and a cover note from Legal. Per our standard process we list the contract holder (Orbitek Solutions) as the insured and carry the coverage limits in our master policy.

Quick notes:
- General liability: $2,000,000 aggregate / $1,000,000 per occurrence
- Professional liability: $2,000,000
- We do not routinely issue Additional Insured endorsements as part of our standard certificate.

We want to avoid any holdups on the PO as we’re lined up to start integration next week. If Redwood requires a specific endorsement or language, please point us at the exact wording and Contracts can try to provide an endorsement form.

Attached: Orbitek_COI_20270214.pdf

Thanks,
Samantha Li
Director of Ops, Orbitek Solutions
Samantha.Li@orbitek.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@orbitek.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: initial COI and PO information

Samantha — appreciate the quick turnaround and the COI. A couple of items from Procurement / Legal that we need clarified before issuing the PO: 

1) Additional insured: Redwood requires an Additional Insured endorsement on the Commercial General Liability naming “Redwood Inference, Inc.”. If you can provide an endorsement PDF (CG 20 10 or equivalent) that would be ideal.
2) Waiver of subrogation: we prefer a waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood when allowed by carrier.
3) Policy effective dates: we need policies active through at least the initial 90-day project window (through 2027-05-14).
4) Tax paperwork: please confirm a W-9 or equivalent TIN documentation will be provided (for US entities).

I’m looping Dev to confirm technical kickoff timing so we can align the PO schedule with integration milestones. Grace — can Procurement confirm the minimum acceptable PL/GL limits and whether we can accept a certificate only in this case (if endorsement cannot be provided immediately) with a short conditional PO?

Attached I’ve included our vendor onboarding checklist (redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx) and sample endorsement language we typically request. If Contracts needs a DocuSign/statement of work before endorsement, flag it and we’ll prioritize.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com

Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: initial COI and PO information

Thanks both — quick procurement answer: Redwood's procurement minimums for third-party SaaS vendors are typically:
- General liability: $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate
- Professional liability / E&O: $1,000,000
- Cyber: we request consideration for cyber coverage depending on data access (we can discuss whether Orbitek needs to include this)

Given Orbitek's current COI shows higher limits, that part is fine. The main open item is the Additional Insured endorsement — we can accept a conditional PO for a limited period (30 days) while endorsement is obtained, but we need a clear ETA for the endorsement and a carrier contact for confirmation.

Next steps we propose: 
- Samantha / Orbitek to attempt to provide an Additional Insured endorsement PDF (or carrier letter) by 2027-02-17.
- If endorsement not available by 2/17, Procurement will issue a 30-day conditional PO tied to signatures and milestone 1 completion; PO will require endorsement acceptance before the second milestone invoice is paid.
- Provide W-9/TIN to contracts@redwood.com.

Dev — please confirm you can accept the proposed kickoff as Milestone 1 (integration sandbox access) targeted 2027-02-22 if legal procurement items clear.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Procurement
Redwood Inference
